comparisons.interpretation: Ocasio-Cortez emphasizes opposition to corporate-favoring relief design; Caruso-Cabrera emphasizes passing the package and pursuing further aid. The reports use overlapping PPP/CARES/relief-bill references, so this records stated legislative strategies rather than inventing a precisely identified common vote or a blanket pro-/anti-relief distinction.

Dolan says the Gaza war is not central to district concerns; Ocasio-Cortez explicitly argues that international policy translates into local resource decisions. These are different campaign frames, not independent findings about what all constituents prioritize.
